summary.zh: 拆解书或长文的论点与证据，并建立知识地图
summary.en: Reads a book or long document closely and maps its claims

description.zh: 用于深入读一本书、一篇文章、一份 PDF 或一组文档，提取其中的观点和支撑证据，梳理成知识地图，也可用费曼式讲解和回忆练习帮助掌握。提供快速、深读、地图、费曼和整书通读几种模式，适合需要真正读懂而不只是略读的场景。
description.en: Reads a book, article, PDF or document set closely: pulls out claims and evidence, builds a knowledge map, and supports Feynman-style explanation and recall. Includes quick, deep, map, Feynman and whole-book modes.
